papers.title: tau2-Bench: Evaluating Conversational Agents in a Dual-Control Environment
papers.fit_reason: benchmark framework, user simulator, environment tools, pass^k metrics; hardware note includes T4, so 4090 is a good fit.

papers.title: SimuHome: A Temporal- and Environment-Aware Benchmark for Smart Home LLM Agents
papers.fit_reason: stateful simulator, ReAct runner, verifier/scoring loop, small-model settings; hardware note includes T4.

papers.title: Gaia2: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Dynamic and Asynchronous Environments
papers.fit_reason: dynamic/asynchronous agent environments, write-action verifiers, cost/latency analysis; good for simulation-backed gap claims.

papers.title: In-The-Flow Agentic System Optimization for Effective Planning and Tool Use
papers.fit_reason: runnable modular agent system, planner/executor/verifier/memory/tools, 7B planner checkpoint; full training is larger, but evaluation and small ablations fit 4090.

papers.title: Speculative Actions: A Lossless Framework for Faster AI Agents
papers.fit_reason: directly matches latency/cost-aware agents; experiments expose time saved, p95 latency, token/cost, and correctness-preserving commit/discard validation.

papers.title: VS-Bench: Evaluating VLMs for Strategic Abilities in Multi-Agent Environments
papers.fit_reason: no training required, strategic-reasoning and decision-making benchmark; hardware note includes T4.

papers.title: LLMs Get Lost In Multi-Turn Conversation
papers.fit_reason: cheap multi-turn conversation simulations and degradation metrics; strong support for a gap about state tracking and budgeted memory.

papers.title: OMAC: A Holistic Optimization Framework for LLM-Based Multi-Agent Collaboration
papers.fit_reason: public multi-agent prompt/controller optimization code; can run OMAC-lite on 7B/8B models and measure coordination overhead.

papers.title: RedTeamCUA: Realistic Adversarial Testing of Computer-Use Agents in Hybrid Web-OS Environments
papers.fit_reason: usable as a safe evaluator/guard benchmark for computer-use agents; include only non-operational, containment-oriented experiments.

papers.title: ScaleCUA: Scaling Open-Source Computer Use Agents with Cross-Platform Data
papers.fit_reason: released 7B checkpoint and evaluation/playground code; full data scaling is too large, but 4090 fits targeted evaluation and small data ablations.

papers.title: FlashSketch: Sketch-Kernel Co-Design for Fast Sparse Sketching on GPUs
papers.fit_reason: explicitly evaluated on RTX 4090/A6000; useful for GPU-cost diagnostics and fast matrix/statistical probes.

papers.title: p-less Sampling: A Robust Hyperparameter-Free Approach for LLM Decoding
papers.fit_reason: tiny inference-time intervention; easy to implement in Transformers/vLLM and evaluate on 7B/8B models with latency/diversity/accuracy metrics.

papers.title: WeDLM: Reconciling Diffusion Language Models with Standard Causal Attention for Fast Inference
papers.fit_reason: released 7B/8B model path, CUDA inference code, direct fast-decoding mechanism; use inference/eval rather than full continued pretraining.

papers.title: Diffusion Language Models Know the Answer Before Decoding
papers.fit_reason: T4/CUDA evidence and early-commit decoding idea; good for a budgeted-decision equation about when to stop decoding.

papers.title: Differentiable Model Predictive Control on the GPU
papers.fit_reason: explicitly RTX 4090/CUDA; useful equation/control baseline for latency-aware planning.

papers.title: Mastering Sparse CUDA Generation through Pretrained Models and Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers.fit_reason: CUDA kernel generation and RL loop; 4090 can run reduced kernel/search experiments.

papers.title: Prescriptive Scaling Reveals the Evolution of Language Model Capabilities
papers.fit_reason: low-cost analysis code for choosing benchmarks with 7B-reachable headroom; useful as the topic-selection guard.

papers.title: TokSuite: Measuring the Impact of Tokenizer Choice on Language Model Behavior
papers.fit_reason: reusable tokenizer/robustness evaluation suite; relevant to token-cost and tokenizer-choice efficiency.

papers.title: Rare Event Analysis of Large Language Models
papers.fit_reason: minimal notebook, tiny-model baseline, extendable to 7B with sampling-budget experiments.

papers.title: FlashVID: Efficient Video Large Language Models via Training-free Tree-based Spatiotemporal Token Merging
papers.fit_reason: training-free token merging for VLLMs; likely 4090-fit with reduced video/model settings.
